contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Gesture Navigation Troubleshooting.
contexts.title: Gesture navigation errors

actions.description: It will turn off full screen gestures

steps: Go to Settings.
Tap Display.
Tap Navigation bar.
Select Buttons to turn off full screen gestures.

actionableDeeplink.description: Opens the navigation bar settings page in device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will keep software and apps current

steps: Keep your device software up to date.
Check for updates for your third-party apps.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Touchscreen Issues Troubleshooting.
contexts.title: Touchscreen input lag

actions.description: It will remove damaged screen protectors

steps: Remove your screen protector if it is peeling or has debris under it.

actions.description: It will improve touch through screen protectors

steps: If you keep a screen protector on, enable Touch sensitivity.
Go to Settings.
Tap Display.
Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will rule out charger problems

steps: Try using a different, undamaged charger.
Avoid using the touchscreen while your device is charging.

actions.description: It will stop overly sensitive touch input

steps: If you are not using a protective film, disable Touch sensitivity.
Go to Settings.
Tap Display.
Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.

actionableDeeplink.description: Disables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will protect your data before reset

steps: Back up your personal data before you continue.

actions.description: It will connect you with Samsung Support

steps: Contact Samsung Support for further assistance if the issue persists.

actions.description: It will fix minor software glitches

steps: Press and hold the Power button, then tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.

actions.description: It will find conflicting third-party apps

steps: Swipe down from the top of the screen with two fingers and tap the Power icon.
Touch and hold Power off, then tap Safe mode.
Remove any third-party apps installed or updated around when the issue began.

actions.description: It will restore factory default settings

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap General management.
Tap Reset.
Tap Factory data reset.
Swipe to and tap Reset.
Tap Delete all.
